items.title: Why Hormel Foods (HRL) Stock Is Falling Today
items.summary: Shares of packaged foods company Hormel (NYSE:HRL) fell 9.3% in the afternoon session after the company cut its full-year sales forecast and reported second-quarter revenue that missed Wall Street expectations due to pressured consumer demand. According to a company press release, Hormel Foods experienced a 2.4% year-over-year drop in second-quarter revenue to $2.96 billion, as total sales volumes fell 7.4% compared to the prior-year period.
